args.title: Cold-Chain Logistics 2026 — Summary (Blog + Companion)
args.body:
Sources:
- https://blog.juniper.example/2026/cold-chain
- https://insights.juniper.example/cold-chain/companion (subscriber content, accessed via team code SUB-1510)

Key points:
• Temperature excursions in cold-chain logistics fell 30% in 2026 among carriers that shared live sensor data.
• Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage — i.e., better visibility prevented unnecessary load rejections more than it prevented actual product loss.
• Companion piece data: pilot programs using this live-sharing approach cut claims by a quarter (25%), reinforcing the operational/financial upside beyond spoilage reduction.
